scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.test:ui: uv run --isolated --no-project --with playwright==1.64.1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_ui.py -v
scripts.lint: uv run --isolated --no-project --with ruff==0.17.4 ruff check . && uv run --isolated --no-project --with ruff==0.17.4 ruff format --check . && npx --yes prettier@3.9.10 --check . && uv run --isolated --no-project --with shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 shellcheck plugin/hooks/*.sh plugin/scripts/*.sh && uv run --isolated --no-project --with shfmt-py==4.2.0 shfmt -d -i 2 plugin/hooks/*.sh plugin/scripts/*.sh
scripts.format: uv run --isolated --no-project --with ruff==0.17.4 ruff format . && npx --yes prettier@3.9.10 --write . && uv run --isolated --no-project --with shfmt-py==4.2.0 shfmt -w -i 2 plugin/hooks/*.sh plugin/scripts/*.sh
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict plugin
